capitalPath.zhCn: 家庭迁移、数学与编程教育及 Bitcoin 写作形成早期人力与声誉资本
capitalPath.en: Family migration, math and programming education, and Bitcoin writing built early human and reputational capital

capitalPath.zhCn: 提出 Ethereum 并参与众筹前的协议设计和组织
capitalPath.en: Proposed Ethereum and organized protocol development before the crowdsale

capitalPath.zhCn: 通过创始人分配、公开持有的 ETH 和后续项目权益形成加密资产财富
capitalPath.en: Built crypto wealth through founder allocation, publicly identified ETH, and later project interests

finding.zhCn: 部分地址由本人公开，但不保证覆盖全部资产
finding.en: Some addresses were publicly identified but do not necessarily cover all assets

finding.zhCn: 基金会国库不是 Vitalik 的个人钱包
finding.en: The Foundation treasury is not Vitalik's personal wallet

finding.zhCn: 具有显著议程影响力，但不能单方面升级网络
finding.en: He has substantial agenda influence but cannot unilaterally upgrade the network
Confirmed by the 2013 paper and contemporaneous record

finding.zhCn: 错误；存在多位联合创始人与核心贡献者
finding.en: Incorrect; Ethereum had multiple co-founders and core contributors

finding.zhCn: 没有协议密钥或公司权力可以强制全网升级
finding.en: No protocol key or corporate authority lets him compel a network-wide upgrade

openQuestions.zhCn: 其未公开钱包和非 ETH 投资的完整规模是多少？
openQuestions.en: What is the full scale of undisclosed wallets and non-ETH investments?

openQuestions.zhCn: 捐赠承诺、代币处置和税务如何影响当前净资产？
openQuestions.en: How have donations, token disposals, and taxes changed current net assets?

summary.zhCn: 强化创始人分配、基金会国库和协议影响力边界。
summary.en: Clarified founder allocation, Foundation treasury, and protocol-influence boundaries.
